name: Your Company
niche: Metal furniture and modern steel structures

seo.title: Your Company — metal furniture and structures, Tashkent
seo.description: Tables, shelving, stringer stairs and partitions in raw and painted steel, made to our drawings or a designer’s brief. Yakkasaray, Tashkent.
seo.answer: Your Company is a workshop in Yakkasaray making minimalist steel furniture and structures: tables from 3,200,000 UZS, shelving from 2,600,000 UZS, single-stringer stairs from 18,000,000 UZS. Lead time 2–4 weeks, 3-year warranty, phone +998 71 200-04-02.

listing.description: A website for a metal furniture and fabrication studio: a strict grid, big type, projects with specs and work stages.

sections.title: Steel, nothing extra
sections.subtitle: Tables, shelving, stairs and partitions in raw and painted steel. Slim profiles, exact angles, not a single visible weld.

sections.label: Studio
sections.title: We make things that outlast the renovation
sections.text: There are six of us: a designer, three welders and two painters. Every piece is drawn to scale first, then built from 20×20 tube or 3 mm sheet. We work with interior designers and directly with owners of flats, cafés and offices.

items.title: Single-stringer staircase
items.text: A 10 mm plate stringer with oak treads and no posts — it hangs off the wall.

items.title: Floor-to-ceiling shelving
items.text: A 20×20 frame in matt black, 42 shelves and built-in lighting.

items.title: Wired-glass partition
items.text: 14 metres of loft-style partitions with doors on concealed hinges.

items.title: Café furniture
items.text: A bar counter, 12 tables and high stools in terracotta.

sections.label: What we make
sections.title: Prices from
sections.intro: Final price comes from the drawing: metal, finishing and installation are itemised separately.

items.title: Dining table
items.text: A steel base with a solid wood or ceramic top.

items.title: Shelving
items.text: Open or backed, any height.

items.title: Stringer staircase
items.text: One or two stringers, timber or steel treads.

items.title: Partition
items.text: Glass in a steel frame, with or without a door.

items.title: Measurement
items.text: A craftsman visits with samples, takes measurements and talks through the job. Free within Tashkent.

items.title: Sketch
items.text: We draw a sketch and price the job. We revise it until you like it, at no extra charge.

items.title: Fabrication
items.text: We cut, bend, forge and weld in our own workshop, sending photos at every stage.

items.title: Finishing
items.text: Metal primer plus powder or forge paint, so the finish does not peel after one season.

items.title: Installation
items.text: We deliver and install in a day, clean up after ourselves and sign the warranty.

items.quote: They built the shelving exactly to the alcove, to the centimetre, and sent the drawing before we paid anything.
items.author: Nigora

items.quote: They did the café furniture turnkey — counter, tables, stools — and finished in three weeks, in time for opening.
items.author: Bakhtiyor

items.q: Can you work from a designer’s sketch?
items.a: Yes. We turn the sketch into a working drawing, agree the joints and only then start cutting.
Any RAL colour in matt or textured finish, or raw black steel under wax.
Furniture takes 2 weeks, stairs 3–4 weeks from drawing approval.
Delivery and assembly in Tashkent are included. Outside the city we quote separately.
